metadata.title: Secure-Device IoMT SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan governing Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) devices under patient-safety-first medical regulatory requirements.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits all Secure-Device Platform trust semantics and applies medical-device-specific patient safety and regulatory constraints.

system-characteristics.system-name: Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) Device Environment
system-characteristics.system-description: IoMT devices include network-connected or programmable medical devices used in diagnosis, monitoring, treatment, or life-sustaining functions. This SSPP enforces patient safety as the dominant priority and ensures cybersecurity controls do not compromise clinical effectiveness or care delivery.

props.name: device-class
props.remarks: Applies to medical devices with networked or programmable functionality.

props.name: safety-priority
props.remarks: Patient safety supersedes availability, automation, performance, and cybersecurity optimization.

props.name: authoritative-regulation
props.value: US FDA Medical Device Cybersecurity Guidance
props.remarks: Primary regulatory authority for medical device cybersecurity in the United States.

props.name: authoritative-regulation
props.remarks: European regulatory framework governing medical device safety and risk management.

props.name: authoritative-standard
props.remarks: Risk management for IT-networks incorporating medical devices.

props.name: governance-standard
props.remarks: Quality management system requirements applicable to medical devices.

props.name: implicit-authorization
props.remarks: Device identity, attestation, or command validity must not be interpreted as clinical approval or authorization.

props.name: fail-safe-expectation
props.remarks: Devices must maintain or transition to a clinically safe state during failures or cyber events.

system-implementation.remarks: IoMT devices operate under patient-safety-first constraints enforced through medical regulatory frameworks. This SSPP does not prescribe device design, clinical workflow, or regulatory submission processes.

roles.title: IoMT Security Architecture
roles.remarks: Defines patient-safety constraints, device segmentation, and reliance rules for medical devices.

roles.title: IoMT Governance and Compliance
roles.remarks: Approves safety constraints, risk acceptability, recall criteria, and regulatory alignment.

roles.title: Clinical Device Operations
roles.remarks: Operates IoMT devices under patient-safety-first execution and change constraints.

roles.title: IoMT Safety and Security Monitoring
roles.remarks: Monitors device integrity, misuse, unsafe transitions, and patient-safety-relevant conditions.

control-implementation.remarks: Controls are satisfied through medical-device regulatory compliance, patient safety risk management, and constrained interpretation of Secure-Device trust signals. This SSPP introduces no new control catalog.
